No transfers before phase 2 and no fabricated specimens
Facehugger stays in the ordinary floor simulation
A directly seen player cancels an entry; damage still applies to the same adult
Flare fear retains priority over maintenance-duct seeking
Visible companion prevents vent escape
Sealed origin or destination prevents new entry
Closing refuses a physically entering adult, then refuses again at completion
Close interrupted by motion or injury consumes nothing
Newt cannot use industrial locks but can listen; no weapon or tracker granted
Anne can lock grilles without gaining a weapon
Player inside the clearance zone prevents emergence indefinitely without injury
Companion also reserves exit clearance
Offscreen time never silently breaks a locked grille or materializes a creature
Announced pressure breaks the grille, then a fresh warning precedes the arrival
A source lock applied after departure does not teleport its occupant back
A full destination queues rather than deleting its twelfth-plus-one specimen
Tracker echo locates the mouth, not a hidden exact creature coordinate
Echo does not initialize remote rooms or disclose the transit to unrelated rooms
Listen records an in-flight movement, never updates the stored reading remotely
Loud motion cancels a duct listen
Import/export mid-flight retains the only specimen, its timer and health
Import while handling a grille cancels work but does not grant a closed state
Retry restores grille and observations from the checkpoint
Dead model does not run hidden transit clocks
A lethal projectile clears an entering body without queuing a dead specimen
